records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Summit Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Next step on your Summit Logistics project
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Following up on my note from Sunday. You've got a project created and an invite out, which is a good start in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the first few tasks to that project is usually the step that makes everything click for a team.

If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through how your team's work maps into projects and tasks. Just reply with a time that suits you.

Best,
Priya
